repetitiveText.guard: not focusable/selectable and no canBeUserInteractive descendant
repetitiveText.matching: Foundation contains; nonempty trimmed child description in parent description OR child value in parent stringValue
repetitiveText.mutation: collect matching child indices descending, replace by grandchildren, repeat against same parent strings
repetitiveText.limitation: no role or subset guard added; full pipeline integration pending

redundantHierarchy.guards: parent not selectable/focused/node-descriptive; parent render succeeds
redundantHierarchy.flatten: reverse original child indices; matching role, absent subset ranges, equal rendered text; replace child by its children
redundantHierarchy.errors: parent error unchanged; child error skipped; context side effects retained
redundantHierarchy.result: transformed even for zero children or no matches

singleItemGroup.action: replace with sole child only if child subset ranges absent; otherwise remove empty or keep
singleItemGroup.limitation: extracted body; complete transform dispatcher and production integration pending

pruning.emptyDisabled: remove iff disabled, not focused, no stored children and no item description
pruning.nonDescriptive: retain own focusability/selectability, interesting actions or item description; then retain descendant focusability/selectability or interesting actions; otherwise remove
pruning.integration: concrete branches tested through tree driver; full production pipeline remains pending

itemDescriptiveState.flatten: self then pre-order descendants; trim whitespacesAndNewlines per string, drop empty, newline join; preserve duplicates
